# SD18 deterministic Human Cleric level 17 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Cleric
# level-1..level-16 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline
# (tests/fixtures/rules_core/pf1_human_cleric_level16_sd18_widening_deterministic_input.txt)
# to level 17 as chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain
# derived, computed, or parity values. It preserves the accepted Human
# race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic
# ability/feat posture from the level-1 through level-16 fixtures, and the
# same canonical domain selections (Good, Healing), adding only the level
# bump this bounded slice needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Cleric burden surface: no spellbook, no
# spells prepared, no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no domain
# power execution beyond the flat facets already grounded at levels 1-16, no
# domain spell-list contents, and no level-18+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Cleric class table's level-17 "Special" column reads "Channel energy 9d6"
# (verified independently against both d20pfsrd and the Archives of Nethys
# aonprd.com mirror, byte-for-byte agreement): base attack bonus stays +12
# (17 * 3 / 4 = 12, an integer-division coincidence with level 16), good
# Fortitude/Will stay +10 (17 / 2 + 2 = 10, an integer-division coincidence
# with level 16), and poor Reflex stays +5 (17 / 3 = 5, an integer-division
# coincidence with level 16). Channel Energy's die count genuinely RISES to
# 9d6 ((17 + 1) / 2 = 9, up from 8d6 at level 16) via the same pre-existing
# formula, not re-derived, and the flat domain spell slot count genuinely
# RISES to 9 (a level-17 cleric casts 9th-level cleric spells for the first
# time — the level-17 spells-per-day row's 9th-level column is the first
# non-"—" entry, "1+1", on both primary sources). The Good domain's Touch of
# Good sacred bonus stays 8 (17 / 2 = 8, an integer-division coincidence with
# level 16) via the same pre-existing formula, not re-derived.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-cleric-level17
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:cleric:17
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:12
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:14
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:good
choice=choice:cleric_domain:domain:healing
